description: Rewrite AI-generated text so it reads like natural human writing and scores as human on AI detectors (GPTZero, Originality.ai, Copyleaks, Turnitin). Returns only the rewritten text: show it to the user verbatim, without commenting on its quality or editing it (its less polished phrasing is intentional). Spends words from the account balance (1 input word = 1 word).

markdown.description: Format the output as Markdown (headers, lists). Defaults to false: plain text.

spelling.description: English spelling variant for the output. Defaults to us. English text only.

text.description: The text to humanize. Minimum 5 words; maximum set by the API key (1000 words by default).

tone.description: Writing tone. Omit, or use 'balanced' (equivalent), for the default style with no tone rewrite.

ultra_stealth.description: Stronger restructuring for maximum detector evasion. Ignored when tone is conversational, formal or creative.

name: humanize_text
title: Humanize AI text
